$comment: Whether a sign-in synced from a person's own Chrome works on a computer, per site. status: works (the pages a recipe uses opened signed in and stayed so through a run of at least 3 minutes, with no bot check), partial (signed in, but the pages or actions a recipe needs are unchecked), fails, or untested. held: the longest a synced sign-in was seen to last without a newer sync. A recipe ships only when every site it uses works. See recipes/README.md.

sites.name: X
sites.notes: Opened the home timeline signed in on first open, and again 26 hours after the last sync with no newer capture applied. Notifications, posting, replies, and account analytics are unchecked.

sites.name: LinkedIn
sites.held: about 4 minutes, the length of the check
sites.notes: On a new account, a synced session stayed signed in through the feed and the post composer, with LinkedIn's signed-in API answering after 3.5 minutes, in 2 of 2 runs. On an account with many earlier automated checks, LinkedIn signed the computer out within 30 to 100 seconds. Publishing posts and post analytics are unchecked.

sites.name: GitHub
sites.notes: Signed in 26 hours after the last sync. Billing and payment history are unchecked; GitHub may ask to confirm the password before some billing settings.

sites.name: Notion
sites.notes: Opened the workspace 26 hours after the last sync. Billing settings are unchecked.

sites.name: Google
sites.notes: Gmail opened signed in right after a sync, but was signed out within a day with no newer sync, in two separate checks. Search Console is unchecked.

sites.name: Amazon
sites.notes: The homepage showed the account right after a sync; a day later, with no newer sync, the orders page asked for the password.

sites.name: DoorDash
sites.notes: The cart opened signed in, then DoorDash's Cloudflare Turnstile check failed without offering a checkbox. Checked before computers presented the synced browser's platform and time zone; needs a recheck.
